items.body:
<details open>

Quant: OCP FP8 E4M3 support (#27512)

* WIP OCP FP8 E4M3 support

* Fix python type-checker

* Materialize input_scales also for FP8 when converting

* Fix conversion of https://huggingface.co/RedHatAI/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4

1. Per row FP8 wrongly fell to NVFP4 conversion, as NVFP4 checked on
   dims alone. Also check on dtype for FP8
2. Need to reshape FP8 QKV projections scales in the same way that
   weights are reshaped

* Allow remaining FP8 tensors to be dequantized during conversion

* Allow tensor-strategy for FP8-only compressed-tensor ckpts

* Fix and test gguf-py behavior for FP8_E4M3

* Disallow QKV-fusion for FP8 temporarily

* Fix conversion of fused qkvz & FP8 for Qwen3-Next

* Avoid fusing FP8 for --fuse-gate-up-exps as we may have different ws

* Emit warnings when not fusing FP8 during conversion

* More FP8 conversion fixes

* Add supported for strided copies to/from FP8 in CPU

* remove unneeded scratch buffer from FP8 cpu cpy/dup path

* add explanatory comments and TODOs

* Add dedicated encoder and decoder tests for FP8

* Whitelist ggml_op_get_rows in metal instead of blacklisting

required to fix failing CI, and white-listing should be more
future-proof than adding FP8 to the black-list

https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/actions/runs/38433916498/job/115422880633?pr=27512

* Fix more conversion bugs

* Defer weight materialization during conversion

* Blacklist fp8 in metal backend instead of white-list

* Adjust indents

* Fix lint + execute tests

* Add fast CPU kernel for F8_E4M3

* Conversion fixes

* Fix remaining gaps

* Enable tied weights with shared scales

* Make mandatory-F32 rules apply to FP8 during conversion

* Fix python type checks
